notes: HEADLINE: no Forge write has ever been committed. All 7 Forge bundles (harvests/inbox/tnr_results_1789049377316..1789124514980) are capture-only with entries:[] and checks:null (forge/src/ui/app.mjs:382); every one of the 113 quest edits, 26 asset creates, 8 ai edits and 1 jutsu create in the record was pushed by builder v4.28-v4.32. Forge write parity is untested by real content.

Real work reads procedures outside Forge's registry: push/05_aerathiel_pvp_research_stage1.json (combat.getBattleHistory, protectedProcedure combat.ts:531 head) and push/06_aerathiel_pvp_battle_logs.json (43x combat.getBattleEntries, combat.ts:383) ran on builder v4.32 on 2026-09-12 (bundles 1789188714166, 1789189076617 = 1.6MB of battle logs). Forge procedure() throws for both (forge/src/transport/procedures.mjs:70-73); builder's only gate is READPROC /^x.(get|list)…$/ (builder_bundle.js:845). gameAsset.getAllFolders (asset.ts:89) is likewise used once (bundle 1788104822853) and absent from the registry.

Real work needs paged/filtered list captures with input: quests.getAll {questType:'mission',limit,cursor} and gameAsset.getAll {limit:500,cursor:0} / {limit:100,folder:'forsworn'} appear in 5 archived manifests (17,20,23,25,28) and 6 bundles (1788104822853, 1788120244483, 1788127352899, 1788134455342, 1788136217543, 1788136356379). Forge reader.list() throws for any non-Names path (forge/src/budget/reader.mjs:73-76) and runner.mjs:582 derives only input.id/userId, so a list input is never sent. These captures fed the generator scripts (24_rank_icon_swap_all31.gen.py reads tnr_results_1788134455342; 46_missions_flatten.gen.py reads tnr_results_1788136356379).

Real work needs capture bodies in the bundle for every read: builder writes data on every capture (builder_bundle.js:365) and the 23 *.gen.py generators consume captures[].data. Forge summary mode carries only {phase,proc,input,ok,rows,error} (runner.mjs:589); bodies exist only with persist:'full' on 7 point-read paths (forge/src/storage/captures.mjs:58-66) under a 512KB ceiling (captures.mjs:84). push/01 proves the gap: purpose 'inspect dialog HTML verbatim', bundle 1789054354501 has no body.

Real work uses `select` projection (push/05 select on combat.getBattleHistory; bundle 1789188714166 captures[0].select) and depends on the builder's scope annotation ('FILTERED LIST: … Absence from this result is NOT evidence', builder_bundle.js:369-375). Forge drops select at normalizeCapture (manifest.mjs:139) and writes no scope.

Real work ships images as zip packs with an imgSizes ledger: 6 zips (all 26 asset creates + the 31-quest rank-icon swap + smoketest). builder_bundle.js:472-511 parses the zip in-page; Forge has one per-file <input type=file> per @img name (forge/src/ui/screens.mjs:145) and no zip reader.

Real work relies on skipPreflight to get partial quest edits past qBad (6 manifests; state/status.json:74). Forge records the flag but never disables lints (lints.mjs:8, manifest.mjs:91); whether Forge's own lints admit a content-less quest edit is not proven by any committed bundle (Inferred gap).

Verification pain the record proves: ai edits with rules always FAIL harvest.py verify on builder bundles (1788204066957, 1788209137361; status.json:77); asset creates under the misrouted entity name were 9x UNVERIFIED (1788118127390); a skipPreflight hidden-flag edit let the server drop objective fields (1788136975366 diff:3). Forge fixes the ai-rules read-back in-runner (runner.mjs:498-507) but harvest.py has never ingested a Forge write bundle.

Forge-specific defects proven by bundles: 5x UNAUTHORIZED on protected reads twice on 0.3.0 (1789066888093, 1789067111434; fixed 0.4.0 in 1789124514980), and 0.4.0 reporting success with persistOk:true for three null profile.getAi bodies (1789124514980).

Counts: harvests/inbox holds 42 bundles (35 builder v4.27-v4.32, 7 forge 0.2.1-0.4.0), not 30. Manifests: push/ 7 json; archive/spent-manifests 28 json + 6 zip + 23 gen.py = 57 files; 41 manifests total. @ref prefixes used: @img: (66, 5 packs) and @scene: (112, one pack) only; readBack, numeric phase, @jutsu/@ai/@item/@quest/@bloodline refs and quest:create never appear.

All bundle inspection was read-only over committed files with python3 json; harvest.py index/get/verify were run locally over inbox bundles; no live host was contacted and no game source was executed. Line numbers were read with sed -n/grep -n on /home/user/tnr-tools at cbb49bae (planning branch; harvests/, push/, archive/, forge/, builder_bundle.js identical to main 305a28f9 per git diff --stat).
